14.19.title: Monostatic RCS of Shorted Antenna
14.19.title_cn: 短路天线单基地雷达散射截面
14.19.description: An antenna having a gain $G$ is shorted at its terminals. What is the minimum monostatic radar cross section in the direction of the main beam?
14.19.description_cn: 一个增益为 $G$ 的天线，其终端被短路。求在主波束方向上的最小单基地雷达散射截面。

steps.title: Antenna Effective Area
steps.explanation: Relationship between gain and effective aperture
steps.explanation_cn: 增益与有效口径的关系

steps.title: Power Reradiated (Short Circuit Case)
steps.explanation: With shorted terminals, all received power is reflected and reradiated (lossless antenna assumed)
steps.explanation_cn: 终端短路时，所有接收功率被反射并再辐射（假设天线无耗）

steps.title: Reradiated Power Density in Backscatter Direction
steps.title_cn: 后向散射方向的再辐射功率密度
steps.explanation: Antenna reradiates with gain $G$ in the direction of incidence due to reciprocity
steps.explanation_cn: 由于互易性，天线在入射方向以增益 $G$ 再辐射

steps.title: Relation to Radar Cross Section
steps.title_cn: 与雷达散射截面的关系

steps.title: Solve for RCS
steps.formula: $\frac{P_{\text{rec}} G}{4\pi R^2} = \frac{S_i \sigma}{4\pi R^2}$ \\ $\sigma = \frac{P_{\text{rec}} G}{S_i} = A_e G = \frac{\lambda^2}{4\pi} G^2$
steps.formula_cn: $\frac{P_{\text{rec}} G}{4\pi R^2} = \frac{S_i \sigma}{4\pi R^2}$ \\ $\sigma = \frac{P_{\text{rec}} G}{S_i} = A_e G = \frac{\lambda^2}{4\pi} G^2$

result.description: Minimum monostatic RCS of shorted antenna in main beam direction

14.19.note: This is the antenna mode RCS for a short-circuited lossless antenna. For a matched load, the reradiated power is absorbed, resulting in a much smaller RCS (only structural term). A short circuit maximizes the antenna mode RCS in the main beam direction.
14.19.note_cn: 这是无耗短路天线的天线模式 RCS。对于匹配负载，再辐射功率被吸收，RCS 小得多（仅结构项）。短路使主波束方向的天线模式 RCS 最大化。
